name: Surface-Preserving Kernel Adaptation
definition: A kernel adaptation method that preserves the underlying surface manifold by adapting each deformed Gaussian kernel to preserve its original surface coverage, avoiding spike-like artifacts caused by naive local affine transformation estimation.
summary: Surface-Preserving Kernel Adaptation updates 3D Gaussian kernels after deformation to maintain surface coverage, distinguishing itself by operating in a proxy-free scenario to avoid spike-like artifacts.
